entities.summary: MIT Lincoln Laboratory is a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC) managed by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology on behalf of the United States Department of Defense. Located at Hanscom Air Force Base in Lexington, Massachusetts, it was established in 1951 to develop an air defense system for the United States.
